name: logo-cloud
blurb: Logos scroll in horizontal marquee with gradient fade edges.
description: A horizontal scrolling marquee of logos with CSS animation and gradient mask fade on edges. Exports multiple variants: AnimatedLogoCloud (scrolling), IconLogoCloud (grid), and StaticLogoCloud.
use_when: Landing pages, testimonial sections, or partner/customer showcases highlighting brand logos.
avoid_when: When logos need interactive behavior; designed as decorative, non-clickable display.
a11y: Images have alt text from logo names; CSS animations do not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
